messages:
maria: async standup — DID: validated ams1 headroom, drained 3 nodes for kernel patch, ran capacity audit for H100 pool. BLOCKER: apac-east1 H100 queue started backing up ~03:40 UTC, autoscaler didn't pick up (no scale-up events). TODAY: triaging autoscaler + opening quota check with GCP, will try a manual prewarm if needed.
jake: saw the spike on metrics — I can repro scale failing. can you paste the autoscaler config? also any eviction events in cloud logs?
maria: logs show frequent spot preemptions, `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="gce_instance" severity=ERROR' --limit 20` shows 6 preemptions in 30m. autoscaler config attached:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  minReplicas: 6
  maxReplicas: 60
  scaleThreshold: 0.65
  coolDownSec: 120
```
priya: quick note — quota request for H100s in apac is still pending (ticket #3245). If autoscaler can't get new instances we'll need short-term fallback to A100 pool + a quantized model instance. pinging infra-scheduler.
tony: I can kick a manual prewarm in apac for +10 H100s for 30m. deploybot will show the action. @maria want me to go ahead?
maria: please do the prewarm, thanks. also set `prefer_spot: false` for the prewarm group. i'll open the quota ticket with cloud account team and add logs.
ops-bot: Prewarm action queued: prewarm-group-apac-east1 (h100, count=10, ttl=1800s) — request id pw-2026031801. ETA to ready ~120s :hourglass_flowing_sand:
jake: also leaving a small CR review on the autoscaler backoff logic. added comment about `coolDownSec` being too short for spot churn.
priya: blocker for me — eval pipeline stalled due to reduced A100 capacity in us-west1, workaround: routing eval jobs to ams1 for next 3h. I'll update the eval-dashboard.
maria: thanks everyone. i'll follow up on the quota ticket and post updates here. if prewarm fails, we'll fallback to canary model on A100s. :thumbsup:
